author: SnackBellTrellis
title: No Random Shuffle
content: Spotify is great for having a beyond-deep catalog of so many songs and artists that will result in your playlists becoming huge.  And that is the problem with Spotify, it cant shuffle large playlists.  It wants to serve up the same small subset of songs in your playlist every time you listen to it, which leads to frustration.  There is no true random shuffle in Spotify.

Appalling.
